lead: A `Core` value type's slots are observable through `Core\Debug::render`, which is how a case asks what a `Cli\Style` holds.
body: A captured stream is `ColorDepth::None`, and `--ENV--` `CLICOLOR_FORCE=1` works on Linux but not Windows, where `enable_virtual_terminal()` fails `GetConsoleMode` on a pipe. `Core\Debug::render($value) as string` prints the slots on every host; compare whole renderings.
